question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT
  c.currency,
  SUM(y.consumption) AS total_consumption_2012
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c
  ON c.customer_id = y.customer_id
WHERE y.date LIKE '2012%'
  AND c.currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
GROUP BY c.currency
ORDER BY c.currency ASC
details.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.currency = 'CZK' THEN CAST(T2.consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.currency = 'EUR' THEN CAST(T2.consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE 0 END) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE SUBSTRING(T2.date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012'
